name: How long does fence-post repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does fence-post repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for fence-post repair depends on the number of posts needing attention and the complexity of the damage. A single, straightforward post replacement can often be completed within a few hours to half a day. However, if multiple posts are compromised, or if there are complications like extensive root systems, buried utilities, or difficult access, the repair could extend to a full day or more. We aim to complete repairs efficiently while ensuring structural integrity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fence-post repair can take a few hours for a single post to a full day or more for multiple or complex repairs.
